interpretation: Per §3.2.6.1, cosmic-ray default operators are AST-local (BinOp/Compare/BoolOp/etc.); none can express OS/HP/TF/SI. Mutant kill rate observed here reflects only that subset of P2 five operator classes that maps to CE-style literal edits. The qualitative implication — syntactic tools cover at most 1/5 of P2 semantic operator space — is robust to the specific kill rate.
